title: NETWORK payload v1.0
description: One fixed-window synthetic node or link measurement; occurredAt is the exclusive window end.

networkNodeId.description: Measured node, or the synthetic reporting endpoint node for a measured link.

linkId.description: Required for a NETWORK_LINK entity; absent for a NETWORK_NODE measurement.

region.description: Synthetic operational area of the measured entity, not a location inferred from its ID.

sampleWindowSeconds.description: Length of the half-open measurement interval ending at occurredAt, in whole seconds.

status.description: Infrastructure operational state at window end, not a detection verdict.

packetLossRatio.description: Lost probes / attempted probes over this window; probes are always attempted in the MVP.

latencyMs.description: Mean round-trip latency of successful probes in milliseconds; null if none succeeded.

throughputMbps.description: Window-average successfully transferred user-data rate, both directions, in decimal megabits/second.

bytesTransferred.description: Successful user-data bytes across this boundary, both directions, during this window; excludes retries and overhead.

activeSubscriberCount.description: Distinct synthetic subscribers associated with this entity at window end, including associations retained during outage.
